alt: Poster: Nifty 50 23,960.60 (+0.63%), Nifty Midcap 100 +1.55%, Nifty Smallcap 100 +2.00% on 4 Nov 2026; Sensex 77,301.40
text:
Indian benchmarks rose for a fifth straight session on Wednesday, with midcaps and smallcaps outpacing the large-cap indices.

• Sensex closed at 77,301.40, up 383.55 points (0.50%); Nifty 50 closed at 23,960.60, up 149.75 points (0.63%), per Business Standard and DSIJ closing reports.
• Nifty Midcap 100 rose 1.55% and Nifty Smallcap 100 rose 2.00%, per Kotak Neo and DSIJ.
• Nifty IT fell 1.50% and was the only sectoral index to close lower, per Business Standard and DSIJ.
• Brent crude traded around $102.5 a barrel in the afternoon, per Kotak Neo and DSIJ.

Our view: a day when smallcaps and midcaps outperform the headline indices is a different picture from the large-cap-led gains earlier this week, and it may point to broader participation. One session says little about direction, and crude and global cues can shift sentiment quickly. This is an interpretation, not a prediction or advice.

For practitioners: after a five-session run, which breadth indicators do you rely on to judge whether participation is genuinely widening?
